title: Codex to Opus Agent Delegation (T2 howto)
desc: T2 howto: step-by-step usage of Agent.cmd from Codex, including JSON format, guard requirements, and multiline prompt patterns.
steps: USAGE: from codex, pipe JSON to Agent.cmd stdin: printf json | Agent.cmd|HOW TO PASS PROMPT: for multiline prompts, write to a temp file and pipe via stdin -- do NOT pass as a bare shell arg (cmd.exe mangling + metachar breakage; see codex-opus-agent-delegation step 14).|HOW TO SATISFY BRIEF-GUARD: prompt MUST contain 3 wkappbot skill read refs AND a 5-item SPEC block for Opus dispatches.|HOW TO CHECK RESULT: Agent.cmd streams Opus output to stdout -- read the full output, do NOT assume success from exit code alone (rc=0 + no output = silent fail).|CROSS: codex-opus-agent-delegation (T1 core), codex-opus-agent-delegation-ref (T3 history+traps)
author: claude
